coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison, prefill timing, decoding timing, combined end-to-end latency, and peak memory usage. Timing metrics are accepted as semantic equivalents.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model architecture rather than holding LLaMA-2-7B fixed and does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its methodology. Batch size 1 and prefill length 2048 appear only within expanded sweeps rather than as the specified sole settings. Decode lengths are 128 and 512 instead of 32. It discusses relative performance but does not clearly specify computed FP16-to-4-bit speedup factors as reported metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the comparative prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or phase-specific speedup factors.
